name: headerhue
description: Dynamic VS Code header color based on your project folder name.

enumDescriptions: Soft, light title bar that stays in the background.
Deep saturated title bar with white text.
headerHue.mode.description: Which color family to use for the title bar.

headerHue.intensity.markdownDescription: How strong the color is *within* the chosen `#headerHue.mode#`, from `0` (softest) to `100` (strongest). Title bar text stays readable at every value.

headerHue.orgLevel.markdownDescription: Colors the status bar after a folder above the project, so every project in that folder shares one color. `1` is the parent folder, `2` its parent, and so on; `0` turns it off. A project at another depth can override it in its workspace settings.

headerHue.orgColors.markdownDescription: Fixed status bar colors for the folders found by `#headerHue.orgLevel#`, keyed by folder name, e.g. `{ "acme": "#e30513" }`. The text turns black or white, whichever reads better. Folders not listed keep their generated color.
